source_text:
Λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Ὕπαγε φώνησον τὸν ἄνδρα σου καὶ ἐλθὲ ἐνθάδε. ἀπεκρίθη ἡ γυνὴ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Οὐκ ἔχω ἄνδρα. λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Καλῶς εἶπας ὅτι Ἄνδρα οὐκ ἔχω· πέντε γὰρ ἄνδρας ἔσχες, καὶ νῦν ὃν ἔχεις οὐκ ἔστιν σου ἀνήρ· τοῦτο ἀληθὲς εἴρηκας.

δοκεῖ μοι διὰ τούτων ὁ σωτὴρ ἐλέγχειν αὐτὴν ὡς ἐπὶ μοιχείᾳ ἁλισκομένην, ἵνα εἰς συναίσθησιν ἐλθοῦσα τῶν ἡμαρτημένων αἰτήσῃ τὴν ἄφεσιν καὶ δέξηται τὸν ἐκ τοῦ ζῶντος ὕδατος καθαρισμόν.
pass_a_gloss: Jesus says to her: Go call your husband and come here. The woman answered and said to him: I do not have a husband. Jesus says to her: Well did you say that I do not have a husband; for you had five husbands, and now he whom you have is not your husband; this you have said truly. It seems to me that through these things the Savior convicts her as being caught upon adultery, in order that having come into awareness of the things having been sinned she may ask for the release and may receive the cleansing from the living water.
pass_b_english: [[Jesus says to her, “Go, call your husband and come here.” >> Bible:John 4:16]] [[The woman answered, “I have no husband.” >> Bible:John 4:17]] [[Jesus says to her, “You have said well, ‘I have no husband’; for you have had five husbands, and the one you have now is not your husband; this you have said truly.” >> Bible:John 4:17-18]]
Through this, it seems to me, the Savior convicts her as caught in adultery, so that once she comes to awareness of her sins she may ask for release and receive cleansing from the living water.
